section_title: Most tools show data. We quantify decisions.
primary_desc: ETF, CFD, Futures, Options and Turbo/KO analysed with the same deterministic logic. A real comparison, not a theoretical one.
b2_desc: Fees normalised per broker. The simulator applies the actual costs of the chosen intermediary, not market averages.
b3_desc: Broker links are non-affiliated by default. Where a commercial agreement exists, it is disclosed inline next to the result.
contrast_line: Deterministic models. No forward-looking projections. No undisclosed conflicts of interest.
